title: Concept: pnpm lockfile in the legacy v5 format
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares a pnpm lockfile in the v5 format, which records less resolution provenance per package, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Older formats record fewer fields per package, so the review sees a weaker graph than a current pnpm would give it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pnpm-lock.yaml (npm).
risk: Older formats record fewer fields per package, so the review sees a weaker graph than a current pnpm would give it.
